extraMeanings.en: to help or encourage someone or something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: My family always supports me in whatever I do.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Ailem ne yaparsam yapayım beni her zaman destekler.

extraMeanings.en: to like a particular sports team
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Which football team do you support?

extraMeanings.en: to continue to exist or manage in a difficult situation
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The company survived the economic crisis.

extraMeanings.en: a small bird with pointed wings and a forked tail
extraMeanings.exampleEn: A swallow built its nest under our roof.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bir kırlangıç çatımızın altına yuva yaptı.

extraMeanings.en: to hit something gently, usually making a light sound
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She tapped him on the shoulder to get his attention.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Dikkatini çekmek için omzuna hafifçe vurdu.

extraMeanings.en: to record sound or pictures, or to fasten with tape
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He taped the concert on his phone.

extraMeanings.en: an object you try to hit when shooting
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The arrow hit the centre of the target.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Ok, hedef tahtasının ortasına isabet etti.

extraMeanings.en: to pull something apart or into pieces
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Be careful not to tear the paper.

extraMeanings.en: to send someone a written message on a phone
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I'll text you when I arrive.

extraMeanings.en: the pointed end of something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The tip of my finger was bleeding.

extraMeanings.en: to move so one side is higher, or to pour by tilting
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He tipped the box and all the toys fell out.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kutuyu eğdi ve bütün oyuncaklar döküldü.

extraMeanings.en: a word used before a name to show rank or profession
extraMeanings.exampleEn: "Doctor" is a title used before a name.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: "Doktor" bir ismin önünde kullanılan bir unvandır.

extraMeanings.en: the position of being the champion in a sport
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The team won the title for the third year in a row.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Takım üst üste üçüncü yıl şampiyonluğu kazandı.

extraMeanings.en: to raise a glass and drink in honour of someone
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Let's drink a toast to the happy couple.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Haydi mutlu çift şerefine kadeh kaldıralım.

extraMeanings.en: a series of performances or games in different places
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The band is on tour in Europe this summer.

extraMeanings.en: a single song or piece of music on an album
extraMeanings.exampleEn: My favourite track on the album is the last one.

extraMeanings.en: to follow the movements of a person or thing
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The app lets you track your package.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Uygulama paketinin izini takip etmene olanak tanıyor.

extraMeanings.en: a job that needs special skill with your hands
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He learned his trade as a carpenter from his father.

extraMeanings.en: to exchange one thing for another
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I traded my old bike for a skateboard.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Eski bisikletimi bir kaykayla takas ettim.

extraMeanings.en: to catch or keep someone in a place they cannot escape from
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The workers were trapped inside the burning building.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: İşçiler yanan binanın içinde kapana kısılmıştı.

extraMeanings.en: to deceive someone in order to get something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He tricked me into giving him my password.

extraMeanings.en: to adjust an instrument or a radio/TV
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The musician tuned his guitar before the concert.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Müzisyen konserden önce gitarını akort etti.

extraMeanings.en: finished; when a period of time has ended
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Time is up; please put your pens down.

extraMeanings.en: to make someone feel unhappy or worried
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The bad news really upset her.

extraMeanings.en: slightly ill in the stomach
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I have an upset stomach after eating too much.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Çok fazla yedikten sonra midem bozuldu.

extraMeanings.en: to do something with a tool, object, or method
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Can I use your phone for a minute?

extraMeanings.en: to think that something is important
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I really value your friendship.

extraMeanings.en: an opinion or way of thinking about something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: In my view, we should leave earlier.

extraMeanings.en: to move your hand as a greeting or signal
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She waved goodbye from the train window.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Tren penceresinden el sallayarak veda etti.

extraMeanings.en: a heavy object lifted for exercise
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He lifts weights at the gym every morning.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Her sabah spor salonunda ağırlık kaldırıyor.

extraMeanings.en: the direction where the sun goes down
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The sun sets in the west.

extraMeanings.en: a complete thing made of all its parts
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The two halves make a whole.

extraMeanings.en: very excited, uncontrolled, or full of energy
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The crowd went wild when the band came on stage.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Grup sahneye çıkınca kalabalık çılgına döndü.
